name: otto-ui-tauri
description: Workspace root for otto-ui's Tauri CLI - tauri.conf.json lives here, alongside src/ and Cargo.toml, with the frontend nested under frontend/. The tauri CLI must run with this directory as its cwd (it looks for tauri.conf.json in the current directory or below, not above), which is why @tauri-apps/cli lives here rather than in frontend/'s own package.json.
